name: outfit420-cloak-watch
description: Local read-only EVE decloak log notifier

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.publish:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish always
scripts.publish:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish always
